meta.title: {siteName} — honest reviews of study-abroad consultancies in Nepal
meta.description: Check if a consultancy is registered and read reviews from real students before you pay.

home.heroBody: Honest reviews of study-abroad consultancies in Nepal, written by students.

footer.independent: An independent site. Consultancies cannot pay to change a score or remove a review.
footer.copyright: {siteName}. Reviews are the opinions of the students who wrote them.

registered.title: Registered
registered.body: This consultancy is on the Ministry of Education list.

not_found.title: Not on the list
not_found.body: We could not find this consultancy on the Ministry of Education list. Ask them for their approval letter before you pay.

expired.title: Registration expired
expired.body: This consultancy was on the list before. Its approval is not current.

unknown.title: Not checked yet
unknown.body: We have not checked this consultancy against the Ministry of Education list yet.

search.label: Search a consultancy
search.noResults: No consultancy found for "{query}". Check the spelling or try a shorter name.
search.error: Search is not working right now. Please try again.
search.resultCount: {count, plural, =0 {No suggestions} one {{n} suggestion} other {{n} suggestions}}
